parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Used to ensure that the resource to be modified is the same as the expected resource. The value is obtained from the response of the [CreateFunction](~~415747~~), [GetFunction](~~415750~~), or [UpdateFunction](~~415749~~) operation.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Account-Id
parameters.description: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Code-Checksum
parameters.description: The CRC-64 value of the function code package.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Date
parameters.description: The start date of the function call. The format is **EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT**.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Trace-Id
parameters.description: The ID used to call the function. It corresponds to the `requestId` parameter in the response.
